title: Transfer - Mine Site Load Breakpoint Study
goal: Study a remote mining complex that runs its own thermal fleet across several independent production load blocks. Produce `breakpoint_study.json` containing the optimal dispatch for each load block, the marginal system cost for each block, and the first load level where a designated standby turbine dispatches above a specified threshold.
skillBenefitRationale: This transfers economic dispatch into an industrial self-supply context and stresses cost-curve interpretation across a demand sweep. The key work is repeatedly solving least-cost dispatch with generator limits and reading marginal behavior from the solutions, which remains squarely within the single economic-dispatch skill.
